shell.approval.plan.default.en: Explore and plan changes before implementation.
shell.approval.plan.default.zh-CN: 在实施前探索并规划改动。

shell.approval.plan.opencode.en: Explore and plan: reads and web lookups run; reading outside this project asks you; edits and commands are declined.
shell.approval.plan.opencode.zh-CN: 探索与规划：允许读取和网络查询；读取项目外内容会询问您；拒绝编辑和命令。

shell.approval.plan.claude.en: Explore and plan: reads and web lookups run, even outside this project; edits wait for implementation and commands ask you.
shell.approval.plan.claude.zh-CN: 探索与规划：允许读取和网络查询，包括项目外的读取；编辑等待实施阶段，命令会询问您。

shell.approval.plan.hermes.en: Read-only: Hermes researches and proposes a plan; edits and commands are declined.
shell.approval.plan.hermes.zh-CN: 只读：Hermes 研究并提出计划；拒绝编辑和命令。

shell.approval.plan.zcode.en: ZCode’s plan mode: it investigates and proposes a plan; implementation waits for your approval.
shell.approval.plan.zcode.zh-CN: ZCode 的 plan 模式：调查并提出计划；实施需等待您的批准。

shell.approval.plan.commandcode.en: Read-only: Command Code researches and plans; edits and commands are declined.
shell.approval.plan.commandcode.zh-CN: 只读：Command Code 研究并规划；拒绝编辑和命令。

shell.approval.plan.muse.en: Read-only: Muse cannot write files or run shell commands, and proposes a plan.
shell.approval.plan.muse.zh-CN: 只读：Muse 无法写入文件或运行 shell 命令，只提出计划。

shell.approval.plan.kilo.en: Read-only: Kilo investigates and plans; edits, commands and other state-changing tools are declined.
shell.approval.plan.kilo.zh-CN: 只读：Kilo 调查并规划；拒绝编辑、命令及其他改变状态的工具。

shell.approval.plan.cline.en: Cline’s Plan mode: it explores, fetches and proposes a plan; file edits are declined, commands still ask.
shell.approval.plan.cline.zh-CN: Cline 的 Plan 模式：探索、获取信息并提出计划；拒绝文件编辑，命令仍会询问。

shell.approval.plan.deepseek.en: Read-only sandbox: DeepSeek cannot write files and proposes a plan; requests to escalate are declined.
shell.approval.plan.deepseek.zh-CN: 只读沙箱：DeepSeek 无法写入文件，只提出计划；拒绝权限提升请求。

shell.approval.plan.pi.en: Read-only: {name} may use read-only tools; everything else is declined.
shell.approval.plan.pi.zh-CN: 只读：{name} 可使用只读工具；拒绝其他所有操作。

shell.approval.plan.grok.en: Read-only: Grok investigates and proposes a plan; edits and commands are declined.
shell.approval.plan.grok.zh-CN: 只读：Grok 调查并提出计划；拒绝编辑和命令。

shell.approval.plan.codex.en: Inspect the project. Block writes and permission escalation.
shell.approval.plan.codex.zh-CN: 检查项目。禁止写入和权限提升。

shell.approval.auto.default.en: Automatically approve edit requests offered by the server.
shell.approval.auto.default.zh-CN: 自动批准服务器提供的编辑请求。

shell.approval.auto.codex.en: Let Codex review approval requests. Keep the workspace sandbox.
shell.approval.auto.codex.zh-CN: 由 Codex 审核权限请求。保留工作区沙箱。

shell.approval.auto.kimi.en: Allow routine tools automatically. Ask you about sensitive actions.
shell.approval.auto.kimi.zh-CN: 自动允许常规工具。敏感操作会询问您。

shell.approval.auto.edits.en: Allow file edits automatically. Other actions may still ask you.
shell.approval.auto.edits.zh-CN: 自动允许文件编辑。其他操作仍可能询问您。

shell.approval.auto.deepseek.en: Like Standard, and edits outside this project are approved too. Other actions still ask.
shell.approval.auto.deepseek.zh-CN: 与标准模式相同，但也批准项目外的编辑。其他操作仍会询问。

shell.approval.auto.muse.en: Work freely inside the sandbox. Muse asks only to leave it.
shell.approval.auto.muse.zh-CN: 在沙箱内自由工作。Muse 仅在离开沙箱时询问您。

shell.approval.plan.devin.en: Devin’s Plan mode: it investigates and writes a plan; commands ask you, and edits wait until you approve the plan.
shell.approval.plan.devin.zh-CN: Devin 的 Plan 模式：调查并编写计划；执行命令时询问您，编辑需等待您批准计划。

shell.approval.plan.copilot.en: Use Copilot Plan mode. Read, search, fetch, and think requests are allowed; other permission requests are declined.
shell.approval.plan.copilot.zh-CN: 使用 Copilot Plan 模式。允许读取、搜索、获取和思考请求；拒绝其他权限请求。

shell.approval.review.unsupported.en: This harness has no agent-reviewed approvals. Choose another mode, or use Claude Code (or Codex’s Approve for me).
shell.approval.review.unsupported.zh-CN: 此运行器不支持智能体审批。请选择其他模式，或使用 Claude Code（也可使用 Codex 的「代我审批」）。

shell.approval.review.claude.en: Claude Code’s auto mode: its safety reviewer approves routine actions and blocks risky ones. Needs a recent Claude Code.
shell.approval.review.claude.zh-CN: Claude Code 的 auto 模式：其安全审核器批准常规操作并阻止高风险操作。需要较新版本的 Claude Code。

shell.approval.full.default.en: Run tools without approval prompts, including outside this project.
shell.approval.full.default.zh-CN: 无需审批提示即可运行工具，包括此项目之外的操作。

shell.approval.full.zcode.en: Always approve: ZCode runs every tool without asking (its yolo mode).
shell.approval.full.zcode.zh-CN: 始终批准：ZCode 运行所有工具而不询问（使用其 yolo 模式）。

shell.approval.full.copilot.en: Use Copilot Agent mode with Allow All on. Copilot automatically approves tool, path, and URL requests.
shell.approval.full.copilot.zh-CN: 使用 Copilot Agent 模式，开启 Allow All。Copilot 自动批准工具、路径和 URL 请求。

shell.approval.full.hermes.en: Skip approval prompts: Hermes runs every tool without asking (equivalent to its --yolo).
shell.approval.full.hermes.zh-CN: 跳过审批提示：Hermes 运行所有工具而不询问（等同于其 --yolo）。

shell.approval.full.devin.en: Devin’s Bypass Permissions mode: every tool runs without asking, unless your organization requires approval.
shell.approval.full.devin.zh-CN: Devin 的 Bypass Permissions 模式：除非您的组织要求审批，否则所有工具均无需询问即可运行。

shell.approval.full.muse.en: No approvals and no sandbox: Muse runs every tool without asking.
shell.approval.full.muse.zh-CN: 无审批、无沙箱：Muse 运行所有工具而不询问。

shell.approval.full.cline.en: Cline acts with its auto-approve on: every tool runs without asking.
shell.approval.full.cline.zh-CN: Cline 开启自动批准：所有工具均无需询问即可运行。

shell.approval.full.deepseek.en: No sandbox: DeepSeek runs every tool without asking.
shell.approval.full.deepseek.zh-CN: 无沙箱：DeepSeek 运行所有工具而不询问。

shell.approval.full.pi.zh-CN: {name} 运行所有工具而不询问。

shell.approval.full.grok.en: Always approve: Grok runs every tool without asking (its --always-approve).
shell.approval.full.grok.zh-CN: 始终批准：Grok 运行所有工具而不询问（使用其 --always-approve）。

shell.approval.full.codex.en: Skip approval prompts and sandbox limits. Allow file and network access.
shell.approval.full.codex.zh-CN: 跳过审批提示和沙箱限制。允许访问文件和网络。

shell.approval.full.antigravity.en: Automatically approve permission requests. Server restrictions still apply.
shell.approval.full.antigravity.zh-CN: 自动批准权限请求。服务器限制仍然有效。

shell.approval.standard.default.en: Use the harness’s normal rules. Ask you when approval is needed.
shell.approval.standard.default.zh-CN: 使用运行器的常规规则。需要审批时询问您。

shell.approval.standard.hermes.en: Hermes works in this project. Asks you before terminal commands or dangerous actions.
shell.approval.standard.hermes.zh-CN: Hermes 在此项目中工作。执行终端命令或危险操作前会询问您。

shell.approval.standard.zcode.en: ZCode’s build mode: it works in this project and asks you when an action needs permission.
shell.approval.standard.zcode.zh-CN: ZCode 的 build 模式：在此项目中工作，操作需要权限时询问您。

shell.approval.standard.muse.en: Muse asks before actions its rules do not allow. Its own reviewer may approve low-risk ones.
shell.approval.standard.muse.zh-CN: Muse 会在规则不允许的操作前询问您。其自身的审核器可能批准低风险操作。

shell.approval.standard.kilo.en: Kilo runs read-only tools; PandaCode asks before edits, commands and other tools.
shell.approval.standard.kilo.zh-CN: Kilo 可运行只读工具；PandaCode 会在编辑、执行命令和使用其他工具前询问您。

shell.approval.standard.cline.en: Cline acts; reads and searches run, PandaCode asks before edits, commands and other tools.
shell.approval.standard.cline.zh-CN: Cline 执行操作：允许读取和搜索，PandaCode 会在编辑、执行命令和使用其他工具前询问您。

shell.approval.standard.deepseek.en: DeepSeek edits and runs commands inside this project freely; it asks you before going outside it.
shell.approval.standard.deepseek.zh-CN: DeepSeek 可自由编辑此项目并执行命令；超出项目范围前会询问您。

shell.approval.standard.pi.en: {name} runs without its own approvals; PandaCode asks before edits, commands and other non-read tools.
shell.approval.standard.pi.zh-CN: {name} 没有自身的审批流程；PandaCode 会在编辑、执行命令和使用其他非只读工具前询问您。

shell.approval.standard.devin.en: Devin’s Code mode: edits inside this project apply; commands it does not judge safe ask you.
shell.approval.standard.devin.zh-CN: Devin 的 Code 模式：直接应用项目内的编辑；对其认为不安全的命令征求您的同意。

shell.approval.standard.grok.en: Grok asks before edits and commands, whatever its own config says.
shell.approval.standard.grok.zh-CN: Grok 会在编辑和执行命令前询问您，无论其自身配置如何。

shell.approval.standard.copilot.en: Use Copilot Agent mode with Allow All off. PandaCode asks before permission requests.
shell.approval.standard.copilot.zh-CN: 使用 Copilot Agent 模式，关闭 Allow All。PandaCode 会在权限请求前询问您。

shell.approval.standard.codex.en: Work in this project. Ask you when an action needs extra permission.
shell.approval.standard.codex.zh-CN: 在此项目中工作。操作需要额外权限时征求您的同意。

shell.settings.generalDescription.en: Text size, conversation density and the quick launcher.
shell.settings.generalDescription.zh-CN: 文字大小、对话密度和快捷启动器。

shell.settings.agentsDescription.en: Your default agent and the agent harnesses installed on this computer.
shell.settings.agentsDescription.zh-CN: 默认智能体以及此电脑上已安装的智能体运行器。

shell.settings.providersDescription.en: Sign-ins, API keys and plans such as GLM Coding Plan and MiMo Token Plan, each for the agent it belongs to.
shell.settings.providersDescription.zh-CN: 为各智能体配置登录、API 密钥及 GLM Coding Plan、MiMo Token Plan 等套餐。

shell.settings.teamsDescription.en: Named teams of models, and the classic team setup.
shell.settings.teamsDescription.zh-CN: 命名模型团队与经典团队配置。

shell.settings.toolsDescription.en: App tools, MCP servers, skills and Jev.
shell.settings.toolsDescription.zh-CN: 应用工具、MCP 服务器、技能和 Jev。

shell.settings.skillsDescription.en: Import skills and rules once, turn them on per harness, and check for drift.
shell.settings.skillsDescription.zh-CN: 统一导入技能和规则，按运行器启用并检查差异。

shell.settings.cloudDescription.en: Daytona, Cloudflare and AWS machines for your agents.
shell.settings.cloudDescription.zh-CN: 供智能体使用的 Daytona、Cloudflare 和 AWS 机器。

shell.settings.remoteDescription.en: Reach your other computers with PandaCode Connect, end-to-end encrypted.
shell.settings.remoteDescription.zh-CN: 通过端到端加密的 PandaCode Connect 访问其他电脑。

shell.settings.githubDescription.en: Issues, pull requests and repositories through the GitHub CLI.
shell.settings.githubDescription.zh-CN: 通过 GitHub CLI 处理议题、拉取请求和仓库。

shell.settings.aboutDescription.en: Version, updates, resource usage, license and support.
shell.settings.aboutDescription.zh-CN: 版本、更新、资源用量、许可证和支持。

shell.settings.widgetDescription.en: Show the live header widget. Turning this off also closes the pinned window.
shell.settings.widgetDescription.zh-CN: 显示实时顶部组件。关闭此项也会关闭固定窗口。

shell.settings.keepWidget.zh-CN: 将固定组件保持在屏幕内

shell.settings.keepWidgetDescription.en: Keep the floating widget inside the current display when it expands.
shell.settings.keepWidgetDescription.zh-CN: 浮动组件展开时保持在当前显示器范围内。

shell.settings.expandActivityDescription.en: Show grouped activity expanded by default.

shell.settings.wallpapersDescription.en: A new scene for each part of the day.
shell.settings.wallpapersDescription.zh-CN: 每天不同时段显示不同景色。

shell.settings.agentUpdatesDescription.en: Keep installed agents up to date.
shell.settings.agentUpdatesDescription.zh-CN: 保持已安装的智能体为最新版本。

shell.settings.turnChecksDescription.en: When a turn ends, runs the project’s own test or check command with your environment (your shell, PATH and credentials); a failure queues one fix.
shell.settings.turnChecksDescription.zh-CN: 回合结束后，使用您的环境（shell、PATH 和凭据）运行项目自身的测试或检查命令；失败时排入一次修复。

shell.settings.preview.zh-CN: 浏览器预览 · 示例智能体可用状态。

shell.settings.integrationsDescription.en: App tools, MCP servers, and skills.
shell.settings.integrationsDescription.zh-CN: 应用工具、MCP 服务器和技能。

shell.settings.jevDescription.en: Browser tests and decision assistance. Your agents work without it.
shell.settings.jevDescription.zh-CN: 浏览器测试与决策辅助。没有它，智能体仍可正常工作。

shell.settings.supportDescription.zh-CN: 在 GitHub 上提交议题。

shell.settings.appDetailsDescription.en: Only the app version, platform, and architecture. Nothing is sent automatically.
shell.settings.appDetailsDescription.zh-CN: 仅包含应用版本、平台和架构。不会自动发送任何信息。

shell.settings.checkFailed.en: Couldn’t check agents. Try refreshing again.
shell.settings.checkFailed.zh-CN: 无法检查智能体。请再次刷新。

shell.settings.removeProjectDescription.en: Its tasks are removed from PandaCode. The folder stays on disk.
shell.settings.removeProjectDescription.zh-CN: 其任务将从 PandaCode 中移除。磁盘上的文件夹会保留。

shell.settings.loadFailed.en: This section couldn’t load. Close Settings and try again.
shell.settings.loadFailed.zh-CN: 无法加载此分类。请关闭设置后重试。

shell.launcher.noMatch.zh-CN: 没有匹配的活动智能体。

shell.launcher.noActive.zh-CN: 当前没有工作中的智能体。

shell.launcher.openProject.en: Open a project in PandaCode to get started.
shell.launcher.openProject.zh-CN: 在 PandaCode 中打开项目以开始。

shell.launcher.started.en: Task started. You can keep working.
shell.launcher.started.zh-CN: 任务已启动。您可以继续工作。

shell.dockWindow.expand.zh-CN: 运行中的智能体。按下以展开。

shell.jevLive.noActions.en: Actions will appear as Jev works.
shell.jevLive.noActions.zh-CN: Jev 工作时，操作将显示在此处。

shell.jevLive.final.zh-CN: 最终浏览器画面 · 只读

shell.jevLive.noImage.zh-CN: 没有可用的浏览器图像

shell.jevLive.chooseTask.en: Choose a task to watch its browser tests.
shell.jevLive.chooseTask.zh-CN: 选择任务以查看其浏览器测试。

shell.jevLive.otherTask.en: This browser test belongs to another task.
shell.jevLive.otherTask.zh-CN: 此浏览器测试属于其他任务。

shell.settings.languageDescription.en: Choose the language used by PandaCode.
shell.settings.languageDescription.zh-CN: 选择 PandaCode 的显示语言。

shell.settings.themeDescription.en: {theme}. Imported VS Code themes keep their own.
shell.settings.themeDescription.zh-CN: {theme}。导入的 VS Code 主题保持其自身设置。

shell.dockWindow.expandCount.en: Running agents, {count} active. Press to expand.
shell.dockWindow.expandCount.zh-CN: 运行中的智能体，{count} 个活动中。按下以展开。

shell.main.simulatorsTip.zh-CN: iOS 与 Android 模拟器

shell.main.selectTeam.en: Select this task again to change its team.
shell.main.selectTeam.zh-CN: 请重新选择此任务以更改团队。

shell.main.teamQueued.en: Team switch queued for the next architect turn. Existing workers keep their models.
shell.main.teamQueued.zh-CN: 团队切换已排入下一个架构师回合。现有工作智能体保留其模型。

shell.main.teamSaved.en: Team setup saved for this and new tasks.
shell.main.teamSaved.zh-CN: 团队配置已保存，适用于此任务和新任务。

shell.main.teamRemoved.en: New tasks will use a single agent. Saved profiles are kept.
shell.main.teamRemoved.zh-CN: 新任务将使用单个智能体。已保存的配置会保留。

shell.main.teamRemembered.en: Worker models for every team · remembered
shell.main.teamRemembered.zh-CN: 所有团队的工作智能体模型 · 已记住

shell.main.teamRoutingOn.en: Worker models for every team · turns routing on
shell.main.teamRoutingOn.zh-CN: 所有团队的工作智能体模型 · 启用路由

shell.main.teamCheapDescription.zh-CN: 可能胜任的最便宜模型

shell.main.teamBestDescription.zh-CN: 为每个工作智能体使用最强模型

shell.main.checkAgents.en: Open Settings to check your installed agents.
shell.main.checkAgents.zh-CN: 打开设置以检查已安装的智能体。

shell.main.attachNeedsTask.en: Start a task before attaching anything.
shell.main.attachNeedsTask.zh-CN: 请先开始任务，再添加附件。

shell.main.attachSettled.en: Reopen this settled task before attaching anything.
shell.main.attachSettled.zh-CN: 请先重新打开此已结项任务，再添加附件。

shell.main.grokImages.en: Grok Build does not accept images yet. Describe them, or attach documents and folders instead.
shell.main.grokImages.zh-CN: Grok Build 尚不支持图片。请描述图片，或改为附加文档和文件夹。

shell.main.zcodeImages.en: ZCode does not accept images yet. Describe them, or attach documents and folders instead.
shell.main.zcodeImages.zh-CN: ZCode 尚不支持图片。请描述图片，或改为附加文档和文件夹。

shell.main.queueSteps.zh-CN: 将已保存步骤加入队列

shell.main.sketchTask.en: Select the task again to sketch a mockup.
shell.main.sketchTask.zh-CN: 请重新选择任务以绘制草图。

shell.main.usageSyntax.zh-CN: 请使用 /usage、/usage daily、/usage weekly 或 /usage cumulative。

shell.main.consoleStop.en: Stop this task before opening its harness console.
shell.main.consoleStop.zh-CN: 请先停止此任务，再打开运行器控制台。

shell.main.error.en: Something went wrong. Please try again.

shell.main.taskLoadFailed.en: Unable to load this task. Select it again to retry.
shell.main.taskLoadFailed.zh-CN: 无法加载此任务。请重新选择以重试。

shell.main.earlierActivity.en: Earlier activity will be available in saved history.
shell.main.earlierActivity.zh-CN: 更早的活动可在已保存的历史记录中查看。

shell.main.reopenAbove.zh-CN: 在上方重新打开以继续。

shell.main.queueSteer.zh-CN: 将后续消息加入队列 · ⌘↩ 立即引导

shell.main.steerShortcut.en: Command Enter to steer the running turn.
shell.main.steerShortcut.zh-CN: 按 Command Enter 引导当前回合。

shell.main.sendHint.en: Enter to send. Shift Enter for a new line.
shell.main.sendHint.zh-CN: 按 Enter 发送，Shift Enter 换行。

shell.main.browserItemsLimit.en: Attach up to eight browser items per message.
shell.main.browserItemsLimit.zh-CN: 每条消息最多附加八个浏览器项目。

shell.main.screenshotsLimit.en: Attach up to four screenshots per message.
shell.main.screenshotsLimit.zh-CN: 每条消息最多附加四张截图。

shell.main.screenshotRemove.en: Remove a screenshot from your drafts before attaching another.
shell.main.screenshotRemove.zh-CN: 请先从草稿中移除一张截图，再添加新的截图。

shell.main.addNeedsProject.en: Open a project to add a task.

shell.main.mentionHint.en: Type @ to mention a project file.
shell.main.mentionHint.zh-CN: 输入 @ 引用项目文件。

shell.main.earlierMessagesFailed.en: Could not load earlier messages. Scroll up to retry.
shell.main.earlierMessagesFailed.zh-CN: 无法加载更早的消息。向上滚动以重试。

shell.main.rewound.en: Rewound to before your message. Edit it and send.
shell.main.rewound.zh-CN: 已回退至您的消息之前。请编辑并发送。

shell.main.forkedSameCheckout.en: Conversation forked. Both tasks use the same checkout.
shell.main.forkedSameCheckout.zh-CN: 对话已分叉。两个任务使用同一检出目录。

shell.main.forked.en: Conversation forked. Your new task is in the task list.
shell.main.forked.zh-CN: 对话已分叉。新任务已在任务列表中。

shell.main.editNeedsStop.en: Stop the agent before editing a message.
shell.main.editNeedsStop.zh-CN: 编辑消息前请先停止智能体。

shell.main.fastSyntax.zh-CN: 请使用 /fast、/fast on 或 /fast off。

shell.main.noContextUsage.en: This harness has not reported context usage yet.
shell.main.noContextUsage.zh-CN: 此运行器尚未报告上下文用量。

shell.main.noResponse.en: There is no agent response to copy yet.
shell.main.noResponse.zh-CN: 暂无可复制的智能体回复。

shell.main.commandUnavailable.en: This command is not available in PandaCode yet.

shell.main.steerRefused.en: The agent could not take it during this turn.
shell.main.steerRefused.zh-CN: 智能体无法在此回合接收这条消息。

shell.main.steerQueued.en: The agent could not take that message, so it was queued.

shell.main.teamTip.en: Team mode: your selected model becomes the lead. It plans the work, starts other agents in parallel and reviews their results. Cheap, Balanced and Best set how Panda Router picks each worker's model; with routing off the lead picks a model for each worker on its own. To choose the workers yourself, just say so in your prompt, like "use Sonnet 5.5 workers" or "have Codex review it".
shell.main.teamTip.zh-CN: 团队模式：您选择的模型将成为负责人，规划工作、并行启动其他智能体并审查结果。经济、均衡和最强模式决定 Panda Router 如何选择工作智能体模型；关闭路由时由负责人自行选择。若要指定工作智能体，请直接在提示中说明，例如“使用 Sonnet 5.5 工作智能体”或“让 Codex 审查”。
